description: This file implements socket and file handle emulation for Windows, providing functions for socket creation, connection, data transfer, and file operations, with internal handle management and error handling.

classes.name: FileOrSocket
classes.description: Structure representing either a file handle or a socket handle.

classes.name: CriticalSection
classes.description: Wrapper for Windows CRITICAL_SECTION for thread synchronization.

methods.name: gen_fd
methods.description: Generates a pseudo-random file descriptor number.

methods.name: handle_db_put
methods.description: Stores a handle (file or socket) in the internal map and returns its assigned descriptor.

methods.name: handle_db_get
methods.description: Retrieves and optionally erases a handle from the internal map based on descriptor.

methods.name: set_errno
methods.description: Sets the thread's errno based on the last Windows socket error.
